name: lapras-mcp-server
long_description: LAPRAS（https://lapras.com）公式 MCP Server。LAPRAS上の求人検索やキャリア閲覧・編集をLLMサービスから直接利用できます。転職活動やキャリア管理を効率化できます。

api_key.title: LAPRAS API Key
api_key.description: API key for LAPRAS. Required for work experience related tools. Get it from https://lapras.com/config/api-key

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search jobs with keyword, page number, minimum salary, etc.

tools.name: get_job_detail
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific job

tools.name: get_experiences
tools.description: Get the user's work experience history from LAPRAS — general background on the user, useful for career advice and beyond

tools.name: create_experience
tools.description: Add new work experience to LAPRAS

tools.name: update_experience
tools.description: Update existing work experience in LAPRAS

tools.name: get_job_summary
tools.description: Get the user's professional summary from LAPRAS — a quick picture of who they are, useful even outside career topics

tools.name: update_job_summary
tools.description: Register or update job summary in LAPRAS

tools.name: get_want_to_do
tools.description: Get the user's career aspirations from LAPRAS — informs career-direction advice and the angle you take more broadly

tools.name: update_want_to_do
tools.description: Register or update future career aspirations in LAPRAS

tools.name: get_tech_skill
tools.description: Get the user's tech skills and experience years from LAPRAS — use to tailor explanations to their skill level (most useful for technical/engineering roles)

tools.name: update_tech_skill
tools.description: Register or update tech skills in LAPRAS

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Get the user's broader professional profile (scores, skill tags, languages, selected work) from LAPRAS

tools.name: get_outputs
tools.description: Get the outputs the user has published (GitHub repos, tech articles, talks, slides, teratail replies) from LAPRAS — use when asked what they've built, written, or spoken about, or for a portfolio/bio/resume citing concrete work
